title: Generate the live Commons IO minimum table and falsify broken derivations
description: Freeze the public UTF-8 rewind and preservation histories and measure their caller-owned bytes. Discover every tuple directly at the stream read, check an independent minimum and its original consumer. Repeat with a wrong result, missing tuple, different binding, and no marked consumption, then measure public outputs independently.

steps.name: Real two-release public observations, checked helper and four falsifiers
